correctness.rationale: For any unchosen edge uv, the sum of selected-edge incidence degrees is 1, forcing the selected edges to be the edge-induced graph outside an independent zero-degree vertex set. The only independent sets meeting both bipartition sides are a deleted matching pair. Exhaustive case inequalities yield the three-term polynomial except the six-cycle. A genuine unrestricted proof is given, supplemented by exact edge-subset enumeration of 1,147,328 subsets and 197 independent-zero-set parameter tests.

value.rationale: A single edge deletion from a canonical n-by-n dense bipartite graph increases the minimum PED cardinality by factor n-1, unbounded as n grows. This structural sensitivity follows from a three-parameter classification of every feasible PED set and its enumerator, not a routine renaming, isolated small computation, or numerical incremental bound.
